source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew verse numbering align throughout Exodus 19–20.

key_decisions.decision: Retains other gods and face/presence idiom without reducing prohibition to ranking God first.
Preserves carved image plus any likeness and three cosmic locations; does not insert a rule about every art form.
Preserves jealousy, service and intergenerational consequence with modifying hatred clause; sentence continues into faithful-love contrast.
Retains unspecified thousands and relational response rather than silently supplying generations or people.
Renders bearing name for emptiness/falsehood broadly as misuse, retaining repeated prohibition and accountability.
Keeps household and outsider scope, named enslaved men and women, animals and gates image.
Uses murder for ratsah in this prohibition rather than a blanket ban on every taking of life; note states lexical complexity.
Retains doubled covet, male household perspective, enslaved persons and exact property list without modernizing ancient social categories.
Renders see across multiple senses as witnessed while retaining repeated perception and distance; flashes avoids overidentifying lapidim.
Preserves fear/not-fear tension, testing and before-you image instead of assigning unrelated English senses with no note.
Keeps silver/gold repetition and with-me relation; stand supplied to make placement relation readable.
Preserves earth altar, offering types and livestock; retains God as agent causing name-remembrance rather than human choice of any site.
Preserves conditional stone altar and tool-induced profanation; notes sword literal form without requiring a metal not specified here.
Retains bodily nakedness rationale without euphemism or speculative fertility rites.
